Disassociated Thoughts on Mushrooms
Note: This is a reflection on prior experiences. Ive had some alcohol and pot tonight, but thats not what this is about.
Am I the same experiencer as when I started? I dont think so. Ive had quite a few experiences where it feels like the wheel has spun, my surroundings and my body and mind became unfamiliar. I remember one time this happened (4 gs of mushrooms and 320 mg of DXM) and I looked at a picture of My Daughter and was profoundly sad. I knew it was this hosts daughter, and after what had just happened, there was no chance it would ever see its daughter in a recognizable way again.
But, the next day I woke up and things were back to normal. I am this body and mind. I think it may be experienced by many.
